sentences.text: Every false alert in a payments SOC costs an analyst's time, and every missed one can cost a merchant.
Telling those apart is the work I do as a security analyst at Northwind Bank, and it is why the Security Engineer role stood out to me.
At Northwind Bank I wrote 30 detection rules that cut false alerts by a quarter.
I also ran the response to a phishing campaign against the claims team.
Your posting asks for alert triage in a SIEM and for incident response, which is the work I want to keep doing.
I would like to hear where the team wants its detections to be a year from now.
